item.title: Kamikaze mosquitoes
item.description: A weird species of mosquitoes (3k draft), any crit welcome.
item.content:encoded:
The title is a bit self-explanatory but this is a draft about weird mosquitoes that for a few reasons decide to fly into their target and die. This is a rough and weird draft at the moment.

Any amount and type of crit is welcome. Clinical, SP&G, dialogue/narrative etc. I definitely need some eyes on it. I have a tendency to overcomplicate things and I think it also shows/brings down the draft a bit. I don't think I can pull off the concept without a lot of feedback.

The narrative and dialogue are pretty low quality in my opinion (definitely not the standard for the wiki). If I can't seem to get it right after a lot of attempts I think it might be better to change these out with a table with incident logs or something.

item.title: Form 1004-E: Proposal for Reclassification
item.content:encoded:
http://scp-sandbox-3.wikidot.com/deathbygin-2

A short tale for my authored article SCP-5118.

Spoiler / Explanation
Minimize

As Dr. Atmos gather information from Dr. Williams, it's implied that SCP-5118 is actually a dog who is a reality bender, turned human, and turned back into a dog when about to be captured. Evidence to support this includes:

  • SCP-5118 did not act like most other reality benders do when discovering they have powers (usually by hiding them from others).
  • SCP-5118 manifests chocolate, grapes, and soda - all things a dog cannot eat.
  • SCP-5118 appeared to be smiling while being chased.
  • SCP-5118 does not attempt to breach containment because it's current living situation is already ideal (it gets a bed, new toys, guaranteed food and water, and socializes with staff daily when they provide it with food).
  • Using it's powers while in containment would risk exposing itself. Since it's implied that it's "original form" is already a dog, the scans / tests from the SCP article would show nothing.

I wanted to write this tale to add a twist to the article without making this the clear-cut canon. Please let me know what you think.

If the only copy of your draft is in this post, you can recover the text by clicking the 'Last edited on [dd/mm/yyyy], [time] by [username] Show more' section found in lower right corner of this post. item.title: SCP Draft: The Consuming Mould
item.description: Fungal infection that eats non-synthetic solids, reanimates some mammals
item.content:encoded:
A fungal infection that eats/consumes non-synthetic solids, and reanimates some mammals. Originates from alternate dimension.

Kejani Hammerborn - The Consuming Mould

Word Count: ~8.5k

Hello! I would appreciate it if anyone could review and critique my first ever written SCP! It's under the tab labelled “The Consuming Mould”. I've been working on it on and off for a while, so there's a possibility that some areas are incoherent as my ideas changed over time. If there is anything that I can do better, please let me know. And, of course, any grammatical errors. Thank you!

Greenlight Evidence:
“Hm. I'm gonna tentatively greenlight this” -Cybersqyd

“Critted via IRC; greenlighted.” -Nagiros
